purpose: Separate individual-arm competence from fused-mixture risk and test whether missing residual cross terms explain the D2 utility gap.

oracle_contract.best_arm: For each sample-region, select the single arm with the lowest target MSE.
oracle_contract.simplex_mixture: For each sample-region, minimize fused residual MSE over non-negative arm weights summing to one.
oracle_contract.warning: Both are target-label oracles and diagnose objective geometry only; neither is a deployable policy.

test_role: diagnostic_only on already authorized official-test artifacts; no checkpoint or candidate selection
